scope: Full branch history reachable from reviewedHead, including the preexisting public base; not just the unpublished pilot diff.

allHistoryContent.coverage: Every unique Git blob was read without a size skip. All 61,855 .bin blobs are gzip payloads and were decoded; other blobs were scanned raw. All commit messages, author/committer metadata and paths including root introduction/deletions were also scanned.

adjudication.reason: Every flagged value is a deterministic non-authentication queryKey SHA-256 reproduced from the public frozen query input. No path or rule was globally allowlisted.

positiveControl.scope: Actual two-commit temporary Git fixture with a deleted raw control, gzip control spanning a 1 MiB read boundary, historical commit-message control and deleted-name control; live credential reads replaced with four non-authentic values.

limits: Pattern scanning and comparison with four known local passwords cannot prove absence of every possible unknown, encrypted or deliberately concealed secret.
The review covers objects reachable from the specified head, not unrelated branches, reflogs or private untracked runtime files that are not part of the push.
Additional review documentation/helper commits need a final full-history textual scan and exhaustive new-blob/metadata delta scan before publication.
